pairing.error.unregistered.message: Set Tabsend up on this browser first, then you can pair other devices.
pairing.error.unregistered.description: Error when the person asks for a pairing link before this browser is set up.

pairing.error.unreachable.message: Couldn't reach the relay at {relayUrl} — check it's running, then try again.
pairing.error.unreachable.description: Error when the pairing link could not be made because the relay did not answer. {relayUrl} is its address.

pairing.error.unauthorized.message: This browser is no longer in the group — set it up again to pair other devices.
pairing.error.unauthorized.description: Error when the relay no longer accepts this browser while making a pairing link.

pairing.error.relay.message: The relay couldn't make a setup link: {detail}
pairing.error.relay.description: Error under “Add a device” when the relay refused to make a setup link. {detail} is the reason, one whole sentence of its own (such as “This group already has the most unused setup links it allows. Try again in a few minutes, when the oldest one expires.”). Place it after the colon as it is.

pairing.localOnly.message: This code points at {relayUrl}, which only works for another browser on this same computer — a phone or another device cannot use it. To pair those, the relay needs to be reachable on your network, and this browser connected to it at that address.
pairing.localOnly.description: Warning next to a QR code whose relay address only works on this computer. {relayUrl} is that address.

pairing.routes.message: The copied link pairs browser extensions through {browserRelayUrl}. The QR pairs phones through {nativeRelayUrl}. Each device saves its route to this same relay; it can be changed later under Connection.
pairing.routes.description: Explains why the copied link and the QR code carry different addresses for the same relay. “Connection” is the name of a section in settings.

pairing.box.linkLabel.description: Spoken label (for screen readers) of the box that holds the pairing link, and the visible label of the field where a person pastes one.

pairing.box.copyLink.description: Button that copies the pairing link to the clipboard. Short.

pairing.box.copied.description: Confirmation next to the copy button. The check mark is a symbol; keep it. Short.

pairing.box.copyFailed.message: Copy failed — the link is selected
pairing.box.copyFailed.description: Shown when copying failed; the link is selected so the person can copy it by hand.

pairing.box.tryAgain.description: Button that retries making a pairing link after an error. Short.

pairing.box.gettingLink.description: Shown while the relay makes a pairing link.

pairing.box.hint.message: Scan with a phone's camera, or open the link in another browser. If Tabsend isn't installed there yet, the link shows how to install it.
pairing.box.hint.description: Hint next to the pairing QR code and link.

pairing.box.qrLabel.description: Spoken label (for screen readers) of the pairing QR code image.
